ABOUT THE PROFESSIONAL

On-site experience. Management discipline.

Luis Jiménez De Faria focuses on commercial large-loss restoration and mitigation projects, where clear communication, field readiness, safety awareness, and accountability drive execution.

His professional background includes site leadership, multi-team coordination, content inventory and pack-out, moisture mapping, and commercial recovery operations.
